description:
DONE — the follow_up-elimination arc is COMPLETE (final commit 0ff5649c0, arc-close three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS 2026-07-03). Work in compiler2 now runs ONLY via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes. follow_up is not merely unused — it is STRUCTURALLY ELIMINATED.

THE ARC (families 1-8 + pump residual + arc-close):
- Families 1-7: converted the literal follow_up.insert pushes to bare waits + demand_fact_producer arms; scheduler demand-on-stall keystone; standing root/activation-frontier demands (has_run pre-filter load-bearing).
- Pump residual (2e431abfc): resolve_protocol_call subscribes to monotone-growing ProtocolImplProviders unconditionally; the TEMPORARY PUMP deleted (concluded producers skipped outright).
- Family 8 (74276cd23): caught the pushes rg missed — wait_on_current(fact, [Job]) threads its 2nd arg into follow_up. SIX new sole-producer arms (EntryDispatch/MacroExecutable/FunctionSource/ExpandedFunctionSource/CodeScoped/ModuleInterface), all red-first-verified; emptied the arm-backed redundant ones; deleted the ensure_*_source dynamic-list helpers; fixed the collect_static_graph ensure_runtime_module regression; simplified demand_function_scope. (Family 8's first cut FAILED audit on a false rg-based completion claim — the audits caught it, three findings, reworked.)
- Arc-close (0ff5649c0): DELETED the dead carrier — JobEffects::follow_up field, wait_on_current's param (-> single-arg), Scheduler::complete's follow_up param + enqueue loop, conclusion_stands, the transitively-dead DependencyIndex::concluded, the [] arg at 25 call sites, the 4 scheduler follow_up-mechanism tests. Audit-proven: follow_up was ALREADY dead before deletion (all parent call sites passed []; world.rs:482 the sole complete() caller passed it unmutated), so no live wake was removed; job counts bit-identical on deterministic fixtures; nothing newly stalls; -290 net lines. northstar.html tolerance clause + fact-engine.md updated to present-tense fact (follow_up eliminated; fact->producer map is the sole restart path).

SCHEDULER WAKE PATHS ARE NOW: changed-revision wakes (enqueue_dependents), the demand_fact_producer arm map (pull-on-stall), standing root + activation-frontier demands, blocked-waiter expansion, and the single submit_root ignition. No pushes.

FOLLOW-ONS (all ticketed, none blocking): coalesced-telemetry split + Scheduler::blocked/has_run visibility sweep (new ticket, deferred-but-verified-live); build_macro_executable's inline complete_job (fz-go4.18.38 — a NON-follow_up push the rg sweeps miss, the arc's next frontier); fz-go4.18.31 (AnalyzeActivation churn SCC) now unblocked (was sequenced AFTER arc-close).

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.
